description: Read a native comment attachment using the issue’s read permissions. Returns up to 2 MiB as base64. Start at offset 0; decode each part separately and concatenate the bytes, following nextOffset until null. totalBytes and sha256 describe the whole file. Attachment IDs come from list_comments.

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

issueId.description: Issue UUID or display id such as OQ-12

offset.description: Byte offset from nextOffset; omit or use 0 for the first part

name: get_comment_attachment
